description: This file contains miscellaneous utility functions for distributed training, tensor handling, and system info, specifically tailored for object detection models using PyTorch and torchvision.

classes.name: SmoothedValue
classes.description: Tracks a series of numerical values and provides smoothed statistics like median, average, and max.

classes.name: MetricLogger
classes.description: Logs and manages multiple SmoothedValue meters, supports distributed synchronization, and formatted logging.

classes.name: NestedTensor
classes.description: Encapsulates a tensor and an optional mask, with methods for device transfer and decomposition.

methods.name: synchronize_between_processes
methods.description: Synchronizes SmoothedValue metrics across distributed processes.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the SmoothedValue with a new data point.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Transfers NestedTensor tensors and masks to a specified device.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Returns the tensors and mask from a NestedTensor.

methods.name: nested_tensor_from_tensor_list
methods.description: Creates a NestedTensor from a list of tensors, supporting batched images.

methods.name: _onnx_nested_tensor_from_tensor_list
methods.description: Creates a NestedTensor with padding, supporting ONNX tracing.

methods.name: setup_for_distributed
methods.description: Overrides print to disable output on non-master processes.

methods.name: is_dist_avail_and_initialized
methods.description: Checks if distributed training is available and initialized.

methods.name: get_world_size
methods.description: Returns the total number of processes in distributed training.

methods.name: get_rank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the current process.

methods.name: is_main_process
methods.description: Checks if the current process is the main (rank 0) process.

methods.name: save_on_master
methods.description: Saves a model or data only if in the main process.

methods.name: init_distributed_mode
methods.description: Initializes distributed training based on environment variables.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Computes top-k accuracy metrics for model outputs.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs tensor interpolation with support for empty batches, compatible with torchvision versions.
